name: cache-keeper
description: Keeps a big chat's prompt cache warm, warns before an expensive cold restart, shows every local chat on one board (/board), and hands a big chat off to a fresh one (/handoff): six steps on a card above the prompt, then /clear and continue; amounts shown as plan-limit percent (5h, week) instead of dollars

handoffOfferAt.title: Handoff offer
handoffOfferAt.description: The context size at which a card above the prompt offers to hand the chat off to a fresh one (off: never). The offer's own control and /cache handoff change it too.
